segments.text: Hi, I'm Aladip Boling. This is my PepsiCo research evaluation review. My current recommendation
is watch and defer, rather than buy now. The goal of this work was to rebuild the valuation
using more current financial information and then decide whether the evidence supports buying
at the market price. For addition B, I used PepsiCo's 2025 fiscal year filing and the
latest interim bridge in my model. One important correction involved capital spending. Consolidated
CapEx is $4.415 billion and includes $4.192 billion from the segment and $223 million
of corporate CapEx. This correction matters because capital spending is cash the company
must invest to keep operating and growing. If I used only the segment figure, I would
understand PepsiCo's total investment and overstate the cash that is available to investors.
That make the valuation look stronger than it should. AI helped organize sources, build
a model cold, and prepare documentation. I recorded that use and checked key values
in its primary source arithmetic. I also ran validation checks to make sure the forecast
statement's cash flow and valuation bridge worked together. Those checks come from the
model calculations run as intended. They do not prove that every financial assumption
is correct. For the changed input test, I lowered terminal ROIC or return on capital
investment from 15 to 12%. I lowered ROIC means more of the company's future profits
will be reinstated and reinvested to support the same growth. Testimated value per share
fell from 117.29 times 11.41, a $5.88 decline. This match my recorded prediction and shows
that the valuation is sensitive to long-term performability assumptions. Overall, I recommend
watch and defer. The remaining issues are the current date bridge, peer compatibility,
working capital reconciliation, and final student judgment. I monitor revenue growth,
operating margins, cash conversion, and debt after future releases. Until those uncertainties
are better supported, I monitor PepsiCo rather than recommending an immediate purchase.
